inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: At the time of the inspection, the bathrooms used by children had dried feces on the wall and paper holder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: At the time of the inspection there were several chairs that were broken and needing to be removed and the outdoor fence had a post that was broken and needs repairing. The busses used by children also had trash items from the week prior.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Water served safe and sanitary: It was determined that unsanitary drinking water was being served to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Water served safe and sanitary (26 TAC §746.3301(f)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: It was determined a caregiver yelled at a child as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: It was determiend that children were viewing screen time activities during rest times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: It was determiend that children were viewing movies for 2 hours daily, and also playing on nintendo switches and tablets throughout the day that exceeded the one hour maximum limit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: At the time of the inspection, eight infant feeding instructions were not updated monthly by parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: During the inspection. a bag full of garbage was observed on the floor of a classroom where children were located.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: During the DFPS investigation inspection, the investigator observed electrical outlets uncovered in the classrooms.     Director corrected this when covers were inserted into the outlets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: An outdated activity plan dated Jan 19th - 23rd was observed posted in the classroom.     This was corrected when the operation posted the current activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Toddler Out of Crib When Not Sleeping: A toddler who was not sleeping was placed in a crib as a redirection/ discipline method.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Toddler Out of Crib When Not Sleeping (26 TAC §746.2907(b))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: It was determined that the operation did not notify parents regarding a child's injury during pick- up time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: There is sufficient evidence to determine that inadequate supervision during children's activities resulted in a child sustaining multiple unknown bruises on their arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: Current weekly activity plans were unavailable to review for five classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: Proof of education was unavailable to review for two caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912): PreEmployment affidavits were unavailable to review for two employees.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: At the school-age building, observed in the game room an electrical outlet missing a faceplate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Chipped paint was observed on walls in multiple classrooms at the school age building and main building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During an investigation it was found that one child was left alone outside unsupervised while in care at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Of the 10 employee files reviewed, 7 were missing items.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Of the 10 files reviewed all but 1 were missing items.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: There are concerns regarding supervision especially during the opening part of the day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: One classroom had a trash can without a lid that had trash accessible to children in care.  This was corrected when the staff covered the trash can with a lid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Two classrooms  with children under 5 years of age did not have electrical outlets covered. This was corrected at inspection when all outlets were covered by the staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: One infant was asleep in a restrictive device.  The caregiver was asked to move the infant to a crib and attempted to do so then put the infant asleep into a second restrictive device.  The caregiver was asked again to move the infant to a crib and did so during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram: The operation did not have an emergency evacuation and relocation diagram posted in four classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram (26 TAC §746.401(4))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Four children did not have current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: The operation has not conducted any severe weather drills in the last year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: The operation has only conducted two out of four lock-down drills in the last year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: One classroom with children under 5 years of age did not have electrical outlets covered. This was corrected at inspection when all outlets were covered by the staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio -  2 Caregivers With 12 or Fewer Children: One infant classroom had two caregivers caring for eleven infants.  The classroom moved four infants during the inspection into a seperate classroom with another caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio -  2 Caregivers With 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1705)

occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.4001(5))
